description: State of California open data portal is an open data portal listed in State of California open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by California Open Data. California Open Data is the State of California open data portal. This search read 4,663 of its catalogue entries in English, Spanish, Portuguese and French; the ones whose titles name a transport, energy, water, communications or other infrastructure asset, network or facility, or a natural hazard, are catalogued as records of their own, and the ... Coverage: California, United States. 4,663 datasets are listed in the catalogue that this harvest read; 195 of them are about infrastructure and became records of their own. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is set per dataset on the portal. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support finding infrastructure and hazard data of this country or region. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-ca-portal.
